title: Final Consonants and Audible Grammar
subtitle: When grammar is correct but not heard
description: English grammar is often heard at the end of words. Portuguese speakers often soften or drop these sounds.

categories.title: Past Tense Endings
categories.description: Past tense in English is often shown by a quiet sound at the end of the word.

categories.title: Plural and Third Person S
categories.description: Final S sounds show plural and he or she in the present tense.
